findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_float, search_sec_filings, get_filing_documents, get_filing_document, get_exhibit_content, search_filing_text, get_cash_position, get_dilution_snapshot, get_dilution_performance, get_ended_reverse_splits, get_reverse_split_authority, search_learn_guides, get_learn_guide · Private data: search_companies, get_quote, get_short_interest, search_sec_filings, get_filing_documents, get_filing_document, get_filing_exhibits, search_filing_text, lookup_accession_number, get_cash_position, get_dilution_snapshot, get_reverse_split_lifecycle, get_ended_reverse_splits, get_reverse_split_authority, get_reverse_splits_list, search_learn_guides, get_learn_guide, define_term · Public sink: get_quote, get_short_interest, get_float, get_float_history, get_split_history, get_cash_position, screen_must_raise, get_cash_runway_calendar, get_dilution_risk, get_dilution_snapshot, get_dilution_instruments, get_baby_shelf_capacity, get_dilution_performance, get_dilution_history, get_upcoming_reverse_splits · Destructive: get_filing_document, get_exhibit_content, lookup_accession_number, get_cash_runway_calendar, get_baby_shelf_capacity, define_term.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_float, search_sec_filings, get_filing_documents, get_filing_document, get_exhibit_content, search_filing_text, get_cash_position, get_dilution_snapshot, get_dilution_performance, get_ended_reverse_splits, get_reverse_split_authority, search_learn_guides, get_learn_guide · Private data: search_companies, get_quote, get_short_interest, search_sec_filings, get_filing_documents, get_filing_document, get_filing_exhibits, search_filing_text, lookup_accession_number, get_cash_position, get_dilution_snapshot, get_reverse_split_lifecycle, get_ended_reverse_splits, get_reverse_split_authority, get_reverse_splits_list, search_learn_guides, get_learn_guide, define_term · Public sink: get_quote, get_short_interest, get_float, get_float_history, get_split_history, get_cash_position, screen_must_raise, get_cash_runway_calendar, get_dilution_risk, get_dilution_snapshot, get_dilution_instruments, get_baby_shelf_capacity, get_dilution_performance, get_dilution_history, get_upcoming_reverse_splits · Destructive: get_filing_document, get_exhibit_content, lookup_accession_number, get_cash_runway_calendar, get_baby_shelf_capacity, define_term

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
